faqs.q: Sec. 46-36. - Duty of the authority and commissioners.
faqs.a:
The authority and its commissioners are under a statutory duty to comply or to cause
               strict compliance with all provisions of this article and the laws of the state, and,
               in addition thereto, with each term, provision and covenant in any contract, on the
               part of the authority to be kept or performed by the authority.
(Code 1981, § 14-6; Ord. No. 1248, § 4, 6-16-1975)
State Law reference—
Similar provisions, C.R.S. § 29-4-206.
